card.name: Start of the word pancreatitis
card.fires_on: The first piece of 'pancreatitis' or 'pancreatectomy' (Pan or pan), often at a section heading or after a sentence end. Also seen on a comma before a place name.

modes.label: Pancreatitis heading
modes.description: The opening 'Pan' of 'pancreatitis' as a warnings section title or list item.

modes.label: Pancreatectomy
modes.description: The opening 'pan' of a surgery term about removing the pancreas.

modes.label: Comma before a name
modes.description: A comma introducing a named town, seen once and unrelated to the others.

card.writes: It promotes word starts like 'pan' and 'Psy' and suppresses 'forward' words, so it supports finishing a word that begins with Pan.
